name: Lucide
style_notes: Consistent 24px grid, 2px stroke, rounded caps — reads as neutral and modern without personality of its own.

name: Phosphor
style_notes: Six weight variants (thin to fill) let one icon set span a whole product's visual weight range, from subtle to bold.

name: Heroicons
style_notes: Outline and solid variants at 24px/20px, designed to pair natively with Tailwind-based UI systems.

name: Tabler Icons
style_notes: Very large library (4,000+) with consistent 2px stroke — useful when a product needs long-tail, specific icon coverage.

name: Feather
style_notes: Deliberately sparse and thin-stroke; reads elegant at small sizes but can feel fragile on dense dashboards.

name: Material Symbols
style_notes: Variable font-based icon system with fill/weight/grade axes — matches Android/Material-adjacent product families.

name: SF Symbols
style_notes: Apple's native icon system, weight-matched to San Francisco type — required for a product to feel genuinely iOS-native rather than cross-platform-generic.

name: Remix Icon
style_notes: Slightly bolder stroke than Lucide/Feather with a broad thematic range including brand/social glyphs.

name: Bootstrap Icons
style_notes: Filled, slightly blocky forms that read well at small sizes on dense administrative UIs.

name: Custom Hand-Drawn Line Set
style_notes: Slightly irregular stroke widths signal warmth/approachability — commission or generate a small custom set rather than mixing with a geometric system library.

name: Monoline Luxury Glyphs
style_notes: Extra-thin (1px) stroke weight at larger display sizes only — never use at small utility sizes where thin strokes become illegible.

name: Iconoir
style_notes: Clean 24px grid similar to Lucide but with a slightly softer geometric personality; good neutral default for AI-native products.

name: Retro Line Icons
style_notes: Angular, chunky forms that pair with pixel/CRT aesthetics — avoid mixing with rounded geometric sets in the same product.

name: Font Awesome
style_notes: Broadest brand/social icon coverage of any library; solid choice when a project must ship without a build step for custom SVGs.

name: Akar Icons
style_notes: Balanced stroke weight between Lucide and Heroicons, with a slightly friendlier corner radius.

name: Carbon Design Icons
style_notes: IBM's enterprise-grade icon set, precise at very small sizes — built for data-dense operational software.

name: Streamline Flex
style_notes: Illustrative, slightly 3D-leaning icon style that pairs well with gradient-mesh marketing pages rather than dense product UI.

name: Ionicons
style_notes: Cross-platform (iOS/Android/web) shape variants baked into the same set, useful for a genuinely shared mobile+web icon language.
